capabilities: Review AI-proposed semantic changes in Obsidian modals instead of native prompts
Copy RDE review summary blocks into the current note
Generate copy-ready GitHub Issue and PR summary drafts from RDE categories
Parse existing GitHub Issue and PR references as correlation metadata
Connect to a kotonoha CLI or HTTP orchestrator backend (or a mock for testing)
disambiguation: Not a Git client or sync tool; despite its Git modes, it never commits, pushes, stages, or synchronizes repositories.
extras: Documentation links are Japanese-language (docs/*.ja.md). Install is manual from a GitHub Release, and the public build is desktop-only because CLI and read-only Git context need desktop runtime. A mock backend allows UI testing without any external component. The /v1/proposals/generate endpoint is experimental while /v1/rde/evaluate is the stable path.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in surface for reviewing, validating, and approving semantic-change proposals generated by an external Kotonoha engine.

relations.evidence: For LLM summarize / rewrite / expand, use HTTP orchestrator backend.
obsidian-git-aware | Coexist with Obsidian Git plugin; avoid metadata writes that may race with auto-sync.

summary: Review console for the Kotonoha/SLS workflow: audits RDE proposals, records human approval decisions, and produces review and handoff text in notes.
